name: Tumult
description: The design tokens of Krönika. scripts/build-tokens.mjs reads this file and writes src/lib/tokens.css, src/lib/tokens.gen.ts, the colours of the CLI HTML report and the colours of the docs site.

primitive.description: Raw colours and fonts. They reach no output.

semantic.description: Roles that are the same in every theme.

page.description: Type, spacing, radii, border widths and layers, the same in every theme. Only tokens.css has them.

docs.description: The colour roles of the docs site and its landing page. Only the files in docs/ have them.

theme.description: Light or dark. Dark is the default.
